title: What `bach ... --json` prints
description: One JSON object on stdout, and nothing else there. `ok` is false after an error (the exit code is non-zero too) and then `error` and `causes` say why. Warnings are also printed on stderr. Fields not listed for a command are not there.

error.description: The first sentence of the error.

name.description: check, inspect, diff: the app's name.

version.description: check, build, feed, inspect, version: the app's version (version: the one everything says, or the new one).

dry_run.description: version TARGET: whether --dry-run was given, so nothing was written.

changed.description: version TARGET: the files that were (or, with dry_run, would be) changed.

files.description: check, inspect: how many files are installed. version: the files that carry the version.

size.description: Bytes. check, inspect: what is installed; build: the setup file; feed: the setup file.

setup_arm64.description: build: the ARM64 setup file, when bach.toml has [arch.arm64].

msi.description: build --msi: the Windows Installer package that was written.

msi_skipped.description: build --msi: what bach.toml asks for that an MSI doesn't carry.

online_setup.description: build: the online installer, when there is one.

patch.description: build: the update patch, when --patch-from was given.

feed.description: build, feed: the update feed (latest.json), when one was written.

sha256.description: build: the setup file's SHA-256 (after signing); feed: the same, as written to the feed.

packed.description: build: the compressed size of the files, in bytes.

url.description: feed: the link the setup file is downloaded from.

signed.description: feed: whether the feed entry carries the publisher's signature.

ready.description: doctor: whether a build can go ahead.

problems.description: doctor: how many things to fix.

current.description: update: the version of this bach.

latest.description: update: the release looked at (the newest, or the version asked for).

update_available.description: update: whether that release is newer than this bach.

updated.description: update: whether bach was replaced. Not there with --check.

install.description: update: how this bach was installed; only a standalone copy replaces itself.

page.description: page: the download page (index.html) that was written.

layouts.description: layouts: the built-in layouts of the installer window, in the order bach layouts lists them.

picture.description: The setting whose picture it shows best (panel_image or background_image), or null.

styles.description: styles: the built-in styles of the installer window, in the order bach styles lists them.

suits.description: The kind of app it suits.

theme.description: The theme it uses when installer.theme isn't set.

old_version.description: diff: the older setup file's version.

new_version.description: diff: the newer setup file's version.

unchanged.description: diff: how many files are the same in both.

installed_growth.description: diff: how many bytes the installed app grew by (negative: it shrank).

setup_size_old.description: diff: the older setup file's size in bytes.

setup_size_new.description: diff: the newer setup file's size in bytes.

changed_files.description: diff: every file that was added, removed or changed.

changes.description: diff: what the new setup file does besides files (registry values, variables, right-click entries, shortcuts, steps) that the old one didn't, or no longer does.

passed.description: test: whether every check passed in the sandbox.

sandbox_file.description: test --dry-run: the .wsb file that describes the sandbox.

steps.description: test: the checks the sandbox ran, in order.

left_behind.description: test: what the app's removal left on the sandbox's Windows.

profile.description: check --profile: the profile that was read.

output.description: The file a build of it writes, relative to bach.toml.

problem.description: Why it can't be built yet, when it can't.

builds.description: build: every file written, when more than the main setup file was (profiles).

packs.description: build: the archives of components that are downloaded when ticked, next to the setup file (packs_arm64 for the ARM64 setup file).

packs_arm64.description: build: like packs, for the ARM64 setup file.

verified.description: verify: whether the setup file is intact (a damaged file is an error instead).

signature.description: verify: whether the file carries a signature (Windows decides whether it is valid).

install_command.description: intune: the command that installs the setup file silently.

uninstall_command.description: intune: the command that removes the installed app silently.

run_as.description: intune: the install behavior to choose (a machine-wide app runs as the system account).

detection_key.description: intune: the registry key whose DisplayVersion says the app is installed (machine-wide apps only).

detection_script.description: intune: the detection script that was written.
